author: ValWood
body:
Hi,

Most of our remaining errors are
	Invalid range for occurs_in: 170

They mainly appear to be  extensions on
GO:0000978
GO:0000977
to capture  the SO-feature describing the specific motif

Thanks

author: pgaudet
body:
Hi @ValWood 

See https://github.com/geneontology/go-annotation/issues/4289 

Since nobody requested that lately, we have dropped this. We should discuss specs of using SO in extensions if we want to allow them.
